items.stem: What should a visual brief define before any image is generated?

options.text: The audience, channel and output format the image must serve
options.rationale: Correct: the brief anchors generation to a concrete audience, channel and format.

options.text: The exact random seed the model will use
options.rationale: A seed is an implementation detail, not the purpose of a brief.

options.text: The number of adjectives to include
options.rationale: Adjective count is not what a brief exists to define.
Model version is not the substance of a visual brief.

items.explanation: Correct: the brief anchors generation to a concrete audience, channel and format.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A generated hero image looks striking but its overlaid caption is hard to read. Which check caught this?

options.text: An accessibility check on text-on-image contrast
options.rationale: Correct: contrast/legibility is an accessibility criterion for text over images.

options.text: A check of the model's token cost
options.rationale: Cost does not reveal legibility problems.

options.text: A check of the prompt's word count
options.rationale: Word count says nothing about caption readability.

options.text: A check of the file name
options.rationale: The file name is unrelated to contrast.

items.explanation: Correct: contrast/legibility is an accessibility criterion for text over images.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO controls apply before an AI-generated image is used in a paid public campaign? (Select TWO)

options.text: Confirm you have the rights to use the generated image commercially
options.rationale: Correct: commercial use requires confirmed usage rights.

options.text: Add a human review and disclosure step
options.rationale: Correct: human review and appropriate disclosure are required before publishing.

options.text: Maximise the number of prompt adjectives
options.rationale: Adjective count is not a publishing control.
Render speed is irrelevant to rights or review.

items.explanation: Correct: commercial use requires confirmed usage rights.
